Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick replies on the RFP. Lyricon Health is preparing our SIG/CAIQ review and we’d like to schedule a 45-minute intake call with your team next week to walk through the questionnaire and request a small set of artifacts (system diagram, sample access logs, SOC 2 cert if available).

Also, please share a short list of the exact artifacts you will provide and any accepting formats (PDF, csv, tar.gz).
